name: VR Music Performance Kit
summary:
VR Music Performance Kit puts your sheet music, chord charts, and practice patterns directly in your field of view while you play, so
  you can keep your eyes on your instrument, your hands, and the people around you.

  Load your charts as PNG images onto your Quest headset and they appear as crisp, floating panels in passthrough, with the real world
  fully visible around them. Whether you are rehearsing alone, playing in an ensemble, or performing on stage, your music is always
  exactly where you need
